20261119-physics-h3.title: Charged particle ine huremu m uye
20261119-physics-h3.topic: Charged particle ine huremu m uye
20261119-physics-h3.goal: Apply principles of Charged particle ine huremu m uye to solve the reasoning problem.
20261119-physics-h3.material: Charged particle ine huremu m uye charge q inopinda zvakatwasuka mu magnetic field yakaenzana B nokumhanya v uye inoita uniform circular motion. Radius r netenguva T yeorbit yechinhu iyi ndeipi?
20261119-physics-h3.thinking.0: Charged particle ine huremu m uye
20261119-physics-h3.s.s1.prompt: Charged particle ine huremu m uye charge q inopinda zvakatwasuka mu magnetic field yakaenzana B nokumhanya v uye inoita uniform circular motion. Radius r netenguva T yeorbit yechinhu iyi ndeipi?

20261122-physics-h3-1.material: [Mechanics yemadimension maviri yepamusoro] Maximum horizontal range R yeprojectile inokandwa kubva pasi nekona θ kubva pahorizontal nenguva yokutanga kumhanya v₀ ndi R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. Pasina kuramba kwemhepo, launch angle θ ipi inopa maximum range, uye ndeipi imwe launch angle ine range yakaenzana ne launch angle ye30°?
20261122-physics-h3-1.thinking.0: Maximum horizontal range R yeprojectile inokandwa
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.prompt: [Mechanics yemadimension maviri yepamusoro] Maximum horizontal range R yeprojectile inokandwa kubva pasi nekona θ kubva pahorizontal nenguva yokutanga kumhanya v₀ ndi R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. Pasina kuramba kwemhepo, launch angle θ ipi inopa maximum range, uye ndeipi imwe launch angle ine range yakaenzana ne launch angle ye30°?
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Mamiriro okuti $\sin 2\theta$ ive maximum ndi $2\theta = 90^\circ \implies \theta = 45^\circ$. Uyewo sezvo $\sin(2 \times 30^\circ) = \sin 60^\circ = \sin 120^\circ = \sin(2 \times 60^\circ)$ iri, range yakaenzana pa-angle dzinova sum ye $90^\circ$ ($60^\circ$).
